label: fan_shroud
prompt: a 60 mm fan shroud that bolts to a 2020 aluminum extrusion with M5 hardware

brief.object_name: M5 Bolt-On Fan Shroud for 2020 Aluminum Extrusion
brief.summary: A thin, curved fan shroud with M5 mounting holes that fits around a 2020 aluminum extrusion.
brief.visual_description: A curved, hollow cylindrical shroud with a diameter of 60 mm and a length of 30 mm. The outer surface is smooth and slightly tapered toward the ends. Four evenly spaced mounting holes are visible along the circumference, each with a circular boss around it. The inner surface is flat and smooth, forming a cylindrical cavity that matches the fan's footprint. The shroud has a thin wall thickness of approximately 2 mm.

features.name: mounting_holes
features.purpose: To secure the shroud to a 2020 aluminum extrusion using M5 bolts

features.name: mounting_bosses
features.purpose: To provide structural reinforcement around the mounting holes

features.name: outer_curve
features.purpose: To define the curved outer profile of the shroud

features.name: inner_cavity
features.purpose: To accommodate a fan with a 40 mm diameter

brief.print_orientation_note: The flat inner surface should face down to minimize supports and ensure good adhesion.

label: wall_hook
prompt: a wall hook that clips over a 12 mm rail with two M3 screw holes in the back plate

brief.object_name: Rail-Mounted Wall Hook with M3 Screw Back Plate
brief.summary: A wall-mounted hook designed to clip onto a 12 mm rail system with a back plate featuring two M3 screw holes for secure attachment.
brief.visual_description: A curved, L-shaped hook with a rounded tip that clips over a 12 mm rail. The back plate is flat and rectangular with two countersunk M3 screw holes positioned symmetrically near the top edges. The hook has a smooth, slightly tapered curve from base to tip, with a thin, sharp hook point. The overall profile is clean and minimalistic with no decorative elements.

features.name: rail_clip
features.purpose: Clips over a 12 mm rail system to mount the hook on a wall

features.name: hook_curve
features.purpose: Provides the gripping surface to hold items

features.name: back_plate
features.purpose: Mounts the hook to a wall via screws

features.name: m3_screw_hole_1
features.purpose: Mounts the back plate to wall via M3 screw

features.name: m3_screw_hole_2
features.purpose: Mounts the back plate to wall via M3 screw

brief.print_orientation_note: Print with the back plate face down to minimize supports and ensure good adhesion.

label: bottle_cap
prompt: a threaded bottle cap, 30 mm diameter, M28x2 thread, knurled grip

brief.summary: A threaded bottle cap with a knurled grip surface, designed to seal containers with an M28x2 thread.
brief.visual_description: A circular cap with a 30 mm diameter body, featuring a knurled texture pattern on its outer surface. The cap has a smooth, slightly domed top that tapers down to a threaded rim. The knurling creates a series of small, angled ridges forming a diamond pattern across the outer surface. The thread is visible as a continuous helical groove around the inner rim. The overall shape is a flat disk with a raised center and a smooth transition to the threaded edge.

features.name: outer_diameter
features.purpose: Provides the sealing surface and defines the cap's size for fitting into containers

features.name: knurled_surface
features.purpose: Provides grip for hand tightening and prevents slippage during opening/closing

features.name: threaded_rim
features.purpose: Creates a secure seal with the container's neck thread

features.name: thread_profile
features.purpose: Defines the thread geometry for proper mating with container threads

features.name: center_domed_top
features.purpose: Provides structural integrity and a smooth sealing surface

brief.print_orientation_note: The flat bottom face should be printed down to minimize supports and ensure good adhesion. The knurled surface should face up for optimal print quality.

label: tslot_nut
prompt: a drop-in T-slot nut for 2020 aluminium extrusion, M5 thread

brief.object_name: T-Slot Nut for 2020 Extrusion with M5 Thread
brief.summary: A precision-machined T-slot nut designed to fit into the T-slots of 2020 aluminium extrusion profiles, featuring an M5 threaded hole and a secure locking mechanism.
brief.visual_description: A flat, rectangular body with a distinctive T-shaped slot cut into one face, allowing it to slide into the T-slot of aluminium extrusion. The body has a rounded corner profile, with a central threaded hole (M5) that is slightly offset from the centerline. The slot is wide enough to accommodate the 2020 profile's width (~10mm) and deep enough to grip the extrusion securely. The nut has a thin, flat profile with a slight taper on the sides for easy insertion into the T-slot.

features.name: T-slot opening
features.purpose: Allows the nut to slide into and lock within the T-slot of 2020 aluminium extrusion profiles

features.name: M5 threaded hole
features.purpose: Provides secure attachment to hardware such as bolts or screws

features.name: Outer profile fillets
features.purpose: Reduce stress concentration and provide smooth edges for easier handling

features.name: Insertion taper
features.purpose: Facilitates easy insertion into the T-slot by reducing the width at the top edge

brief.print_orientation_note: The flat face with the T-slot should be oriented downward to minimize support structures needed during printing.
